name: 80017 · Aurora, CO
findings: ZIP 80017 (Aurora) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80017 (Aurora) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80017 (Aurora) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).
